observations: Photo 0 shows one light-colored wooden pallet lying flat on a concrete floor; it appears clean and dry with standard slat construction and bottom boards.
Photo 1 shows the same light-colored wooden pallet from a slightly different angle; no obvious damage or staining is visible.
Photo 2 shows a stack of darker, weathered wooden pallets outdoors; the wood looks used and worn compared to photos 0 and 1.
All photos carry the watermark "POSTED ON JIJI" and "DANTILA RESOURCES".
No brand, model, or identifying stamp is legible on any pallet in any photo.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows weathered, darker pallets that are not clean like those in photos 0 and 1.
Photos cannot show moisture content or whether water was added.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale, weight ticket, or weighing process is visible in any photo.

risks.risk: Pallets may be damp or have added water despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A moisture meter reading or a photo of a recent certified scale/weight ticket.
risks.if_unproven: priced as damp or lower-grade pallets.

risks.risk: The lot may include weathered or damaged pallets like those in photo 2 rather than only clean pallets like photos 0 and 1.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of every pallet in the lot, especially corners, blocks, and underside.

risks.risk: Actual quantity or total weight may differ from the claimed 500 kg.
risks.proof: A scale ticket showing 500 kg and a count of the pallets.
risks.if_unproven: priced per pallet at worst-case condition with unknown quantity.

risks.risk: Structural defects such as broken slats, missing blocks, or cracks may not be visible in the flat-lay photos.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of pallet corners, stringers/blocks, and underside.

proof_requests: A photo of the scale ticket or scale display showing 500 kg.
Close-up photos of the pallets being sold, especially corners, blocks, and underside, to confirm condition matches photos 0 and 1.
A moisture meter reading or confirmation that pallets are stored dry.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as wooden pallets, so it can be priced at its worst case as seen (used, weathered, unverified weight and condition).
